notes: v1.1.90: small update (only changed files). Browser language is now always English (US) whatever country the proxy is in (time zone + location still follow the proxy) - a French/Vietnamese/Bangla proxy no longer turns Facebook into that language. Accounts already in another language are switched to English using their 2FA key when Facebook asks for a code (before: email code only, then left alone for 30 days). Facebook's 'Save your login info?' page is recognised in any language, so login no longer gets stuck there.
